title: ADHD and lifestyle factors
summary: This study examines lifestyle habits in adults with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) compared to those without mental health conditions. Participants will complete questionnaires on areas such as physical activity, diet, sleep, substance use, and social media use. The findings aim to support the development of targeted interventions to improve the health and quality of life of adults with ADHD.

interventions.name:
Adults with ADHD (cases)
Participants respond to questionnaires on topics such as physical activity, nutrition, sleep, substance use and the use of digital media.

Adults without ADHD/mental disorders (controls)
Participants respond to questionnaires on topics such as physical activity, nutrition, sleep, substance use and the use of digital media.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosed ADHD (ADHD group)
Participants need to answer screening question about mental disorders with “no" (control group)
Exclusion criteria:
Careless responding (Meade & Craig, 2012)
